name: application-leaderboard-podium
title: Leaderboard Podium
description: Top-3 podium visualizations with medals, avatars, and scores, plus a ranked medal-row list for competitive and gamified interfaces.
useWhen: Top-3 podium visualizations with medals, avatars, and scores, plus a ranked medal-row list for competitive and gamified interfaces.
avoidWhen: Avoid leaderboard podium when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Leaderboard Podium uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
